scientific_integrity: The exact formula is proved analytically by sign-block summation and finite cosine sums; the asymptotic coefficient follows from derivative jumps and absolutely convergent Fourier sampling. Numerical replay is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Consecutive frequency blocks and endpoint \(\ell^1\) and \(\ell^\infty\) norms only; the \(O_m(N^{-3})\) remainder is for fixed \(m\) and is not uniform for growing \(m\).
title: Exact endpoint norms and residue law for consecutive cyclic Fourier projections
